reviews.text: (Translated by Google) Nice place to eat. Delicious lamb and breaded cutlet. Very good mayonnaise. Best descent Melbourne Australia (Original) Bonito lugar para comer Rico el Cordero y la Milanesa muy buena la mayonesa mejor descent Melbourne Australia

What looks like a hole in the wall type restaurant.....wow. Might not look fancy but the best lamb I have ever eaten with a fantastic homemade relish type sauce. Wife had pork belly...beautifully cooked, moist. This is food made with love. Thank you.

We had a really lovely experience here. The food was delicious, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the service made the evening even better. A special mention to Miss Candelaria, who looked after us incredibly well. She was friendly, attentive, professional, and made us feel very welcome. It was also a lovely surprise to meet a fellow Argentinian so far from home! Thank you, Candelaria, for the great service and for making our dinner such an enjoyable experience. Highly recommended!

Amazing little spot in Riverside Markets, for such a satisfying and filling feed. We ordered the beef and chicken empanadas which were both delicious and fresh, and the share platter with such a great range of meats. Everything was perfectly cooked and so flavourful, especially with the great sauces. The portion we ordered was for one, so I can imagine the full platter would be very a good feed for two. Personally, I loved the rump cap and the pork belly.
Great atmosphere, service and staff. And the food…well, you’ll have to go check it out. Everything is made in house including the sauces and bread- yum!
